awesome-project

A blazingly fast tool for doing things with data. Built in Rust with zero dependencies.

Features

  • Zero-copy parsing for maximum throughput
  • Async/await support with Tokio runtime
  • Plugin system for extensibility
  • Cross-platform: Linux, macOS, Windows, WASM

Installation

cargo install awesome-project

Or add to your Cargo.toml:

[dependencies]
awesome-project = "1.0"

Quick Start

use awesome_project::Pipeline;

let result = Pipeline::new()
    .source("data.csv")
    .filter(|row| row.age > 18)
    .transform(|row| row.name.to_uppercase())
    .collect();
